$comment: Catalog of what scdemos/demo already provides. The customer-demo skill maps customer components onto these before writing any new code. Keep in sync when blocks/variants/section styles change.

brandSlots.$comment: Blocks use semantic tokens (--color-*, --gap-*, --step-*, --radius-*), which all derive from the brand primitives between BRAND TOKENS:start and :end at the top of styles/styles.css. Re-theming = re-assigning those primitive values. Do not rename them.

colors.--ink-1000 .. --ink-700: dark ramp: text on light, dark scheme and `ink` / `band` sections
colors.--stone-600 .. --stone-50: neutral ramp: muted text, borders, light surfaces
colors.--flame-700 .. --flame-100: primary brand colour: buttons, links, `flame` sections (600 must keep 4.5:1 with white)
colors.--aurora-600 .. --aurora-100: cool accent: secondary colour, gradient end, dark-section glow
colors.--volt-400: highlight / focus colour in dark scheme
colors.--gradient-vivid: brand gradient built from flame, magenta and aurora

typography.--brand-font-sans: brand font stack (declared in styles/fonts.css, files in /fonts); --font-sans and --font-display derive from it

brandSlots.darkMode: [data-theme='dark'] re-maps the semantic tokens; `ink` and `band` sections reuse the same mapping, so blocks inside them turn light automatically.

sectionStyles.$comment: Applied with a Section Metadata block, key 'style'. Combine with commas.
sectionStyles.wide: wider content width (92rem); images become 21:9 banners
sectionStyles.cover: an image + caption laid out like a cover card
sectionStyles.band: full-bleed color band (default ink) with light text; a lone image paragraph fills the right edge; modifiers band-green | band-purple | band-blue
sectionStyles.overlap: follows a band: pulls its panel/stats/form up into the band (desktop)
sectionStyles.tags: lists render as pill clouds (browse by tag/category/author, all tags)
sectionStyles.page-title: plain title band: optional icon paragraph above the H1 (simple landing pages: contact, search, insights hub)
sectionStyles.social: links rendered as raised cards (Stay connected)
sectionStyles.head-row: heading left, lone link paragraph right (e.g. "Latest news" ... "All news")

hero.use: page-top hero: text with one picture (or a light + dark pair). home = flagship first viewport; ink = dark; no-image = text only; banner = full-bleed photo behind a dark gradient, white text (corporate/FS sites)

cards.use: default = image grid; links = cards for authored page links (title, image, description from the query index); tiles = icon tiles; stories = lead story + grid; cover = one wide feature card; tiers = one row per plan with an optional badge line; bento = mixed-size grid; panel = one raised panel with hairline-separated cells (capabilities, ESG, news; with or without images); cols-2 / cols-4 set the columns; emphasis = larger headings (contact cards); text = text-only tiles; list = rows with date/title/author byline (paragraph with headshot picture) + thumbnail; switchable adds a grid/list toggle (JS); stats = big figures; promo = image + text feature tile (ink = dark, wide = one per row); logos = partner/membership logo wall

columns.use: side-by-side text/media (split layouts, feature rows); media = art-directed image + text split

teaser.use: single promo: image + heading + copy + CTA

faq.use: INDEX-DRIVEN: rows are category names, Q&A come from /faq-index.json. For authored Q&A use tabs instead.

related-articles.use: auto list of articles/insights from query-index

product-grid.use: grid driven by a JSON index (products, funds, strategies)

form.use: spreadsheet-driven form: row 1 = link to /forms/<name>.json (field,type,label,options,required,...), row 2 = submit URL (https://demo.bbird.live/contact-us/ allows any origin); panel = white raised form card. Sheet options are pipe-delimited (Asia|EMEA); end a single comma-containing option with | ; required accepts TRUE/true

n8n-form.use: form posting to an n8n webhook (contact / subscribe)

auth-toggle.use: author-host preview toggle for gated pages (logged-in / logged-out views)

carousel.use: rotating hero/promo slides with prev/next arrows, dots (progress pill when autoplay), keyboard + reduced-motion support. Each row = image cell | content cell.

campaign.use: featured offer band: picture, body (eyebrow, h2, lede, buttons) and an optional meta list (**value** label)

quote.use: testimonial / pull quote: quote text, attribution (**Name** + role), optional picture

stats.use: proof figures: number + label rows; optional intro row; optional ticker list

timeline.use: dated entries, newest first (what's new, history)

toc.use: on-this-page list with optional governance facts (Last updated | date); turns its section into a two-column layout from 900px

events.use: event listing from authored rows with date, filters and count (config keys filter, filter-label, count, empty)

catalog.use: filterable product catalog driven by a JSON sheet (source)

product-detail.use: product page header: gallery, price, availability, rating, plans (config keys sku, price, currency, …); emits Product structured data

offer-summary.use: offer / sale summary with price, dates, optional countdown and share link

locations.use: store / location finder: toolbar, map and cards from a JSON sheet (source)

booking.use: multi-step booking flow (experience, date, details) from a JSON sheet; embeddable with aem-embed

journeys.use: Studio: list of demo journeys (authored links or <studio>/journeys.json)

journey-steps.use: Studio: one row per demo step (title + page link, talk track, capabilities)

templates.article: insight / article pages (metadata: Template = article): byline in the hero
templates.journey: single-column talk track for solution consultants (Studio journeys)

features.experimentation: plugins/experimentation: experiments, audiences, campaigns + sidekick overlay
features.martech: plugins/martech: Adobe Web SDK (alloy), Target offers incl. section-level decision scopes
features.cloneit: tools/cloneit: repoless clone of a DA template site
features.queryIndex: query.yaml (site config) feeding related-articles, search, product-grid

siteNotices.use: metadata site-gate: /fragments/<disclaimer> (modal with #agree/#cancel links; site-gate-exit for cancel) and consent: /fragments/<consent> (banner with #accept/#reject/#settings, optional category list). Choices persist in localStorage and drive Web SDK consent via martech updateUserConsent.

login.use: header builds the login/logout link to demo.bbird.live (base auth flow, keep it there); customer wording via metadata login-label / logout-label

gatedContent.use: page metadata Gated: true + section metadata View: logged-in | logged-out (teaser vs member content); author toggle on aem.page/localhost, enforced by the CDN worker + Cloudflare Access on the gated production host

templates.use: Template: article (insights/news, breadcrumb, date) and Template: events (listing); add a new template for a page type that appears on 2+ pages

mappingRules: Fidelity first: never force a customer pattern into a block if it changes the look; never drop content.

Pick the lowest level that reproduces the pattern faithfully: 0 default content, 1 existing block, 2 section style, 3 CSS-only variant, 4 variant with JS, 5 new block, 6 header/footer chrome variant via site metadata, 7 template, 8 global feature/plugin.
New block when the content model, interaction or over ~40% of the CSS differs; otherwise a variant.
Name everything generically; record level, content model and baseCandidate in this manifest.

Section-driven blocks (tabs = Tab Id/Tab title section metadata; faq = /faq-index.json) must not be authored as row tables. When the original shows tiles, use cards panel; timelines use table striped.
Text on colored bands/overlaps must be verified against what is painted under it, not its DOM parent (capture.mjs readability check).
Content repeated on 2+ pages (CTA band, sign-up, disclaimer, contact strip) is one /fragments/<generic-name> doc, placed with a fragment block on each page (lint:repeat-inline).

pageMetadata.social-share: off hides the floating share dock (delayed.js)
pageMetadata.Experiment / Experiment Variants: page-level A/B: variants are full pages, relative paths OK
pageMetadata.Campaign-<name>: value must be the served URL of the campaign page: a DA doc named index is served at the FOLDER url (/campaigns/x/), not /campaigns/x/index
pageMetadata.color-scheme: light | dark | auto (default). Set light/dark site-wide in metadata.json when the customer has no dark mode, so the OS preference cannot flip the demo
pageMetadata.gated: true makes logged-in / logged-out sections (section metadata View) apply; server-side on demo.bbird.live, preview toggle on author hosts
pageMetadata.login-label / logout-label: override the header sign-in / sign-out link text

header nav-layout: rail.use: fixed left icon rail for primary sections (icons via :rail-*: in nav), square brand mark (:rail-mark:), wide top search, secondary CTA buttons; collapses to hamburger below 900px

footer footer-layout: legal.use: logo + link row, copyright/legal paragraphs, stacked legal links (corporate/FS footers)

login-label / logout-label.use: metadata overrides for auth link text

baseContentMarkers.$comment: Strings that only exist in the base demo content. Any of them on a customer page means base content leaked (P6). lint-content.mjs fails on them.
